summary: A compact multi-sheet simulation used to compare per-region, per-model COGS at different cache and batching assumptions and to produce routing + pricing recommendations for the hosted API product tier.

04_routing_playbook_and_recs:
routing_rule,when_to_use,expected_econ_impact,operational_risk
prefer-compact-for-latency-sensitive,latency SLA <150ms and request <= 200 tokens,-35% unit cost vs large model,low (quality tradeoff)
graded-fallback-medium,when primary large-model queue overloaded reduce to medium-13b,-25% unit cost,moderate (some quality regression)
regional-routing-by-price,if quoted price tier < X use region with lowest COGS for that model,+3-8% margin uplift (booked),moderate (data residency complexity)
edge-cache-first,for high reuse workloads route to cached prefix store,-18% unit cost,low
reserve-burst-pool,for 99.99th p95 demand use pre-warmed reserved pool,mitigates tail cost spikes,high (capacity planning)
recommendations, "1) Launch a 3-week A/B with prefer-compact-for-latency-sensitive for mobile chat flows (metrics: latency p95, quality regressions, token savings). 2) Introduce a regional price-break promotion for EU to validate willingness-to-pay while monitoring margin. 3) Implement telemetry tag for cache-hit-rate per-route and tie to billing analytics; if hit rate > 20% enable cache-first routing automatically. 4) Add unit-tests in routing engine for graceful fallback ordering to ensure quality floor. 5) Re-run full sim with real traffic profile after 30 days and check delta against amortization assumptions."
notes: This sheet is intended as an operational playbook and quick simulator rather than a final financial model. Numbers are illustrative; use tagging instrumentation from infra to replace assumptions with actuals. Key knobs: batching policy, KV cache thresholds, regional price deltas, and license pass-throughs. Primary risk is latency regression from large-batch strategies and complexity from multi-region routing with data residency constraints.
recommended_actions:
- Instrument: per-route token-level cost telemetry (GPU-hw, energy, license tags)
- Experiment: 3-week prefer-compact A/B on mobile flows; measure quality with small eval set
- Policy: default regional-routing table with cost-margin thresholds and enterprise overrides
- Product: add per-request explanation in logs when a fallback model was used (for customer debugging)
- Finance: translate per_1M USD to monthly P&L scenario at low/medium/high volume and share with revenue ops by next review
raw_footnotes: - Amortization simplifications used to keep sheet compact. - Egress and cloud discounts vary at scale; financial team should plug negotiated rates for committed capacity. - Latency impacts are order-of-magnitude sketches; SRE must run p95 experiments with real tracing. - Cache hit rate improvement often depends on prompt design and SDK-side client caching.
